## Projects

### BlankReel
- **Type:** Web Application / Video Generation Engine
- **Website:** https://blankreel.com/
- **Description:** An API-first programmatic video generation platform featuring timeline editing, dynamic scene generation, kinetic typography, and integrations for n8n, Make, and Python.

### BeatsFlow
- **Type:** Web Application / Audio Tool
- **Website:** https://www.getbeatsflow.com/
- **Description:** An AI music workstation that generates instrumental beats from prompts and separates audio into 4 isolated stems (Drums, Bass, Melody, FX) for digital audio workstations (FL Studio, Ableton, Logic Pro).

### RepoFlows
- **Type:** Web Application & Open Source Tool
- **Website:** https://www.repoflows.com/
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/emirgms-creator/repoflows
- **Description:** An interactive architecture visualization tool that transforms GitHub repositories into animated system topology diagrams.

### Halt Core
- **Type:** Open Source Security SDK (Python)
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/emirgms-creator/halt-core
- **PyPI:** https://pypi.org/project/halt-core/
- **Description:** A zero-trust execution guardrail and middleware SDK for autonomous AI agents. Uses Python AST (Abstract Syntax Tree) analysis and shell parsing to intercept and block unsafe commands and sandbox escapes locally.

### Parse Core
- **Type:** Open Source Data Pipeline (Go)
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/emirgms-creator/parse-core
- **Description:** An air-gapped, local data ingestion pipeline written in Go. Extracts text from PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT, Markdown, and web pages, chunks data semantically, and outputs structured JSON via local LLMs.

### KnightVision
- **Type:** Chrome Extension (Manifest V3)
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/emirgms-creator/KnightVision
- **Description:** A chess board perception HUD and Stockfish companion built with Chrome Manifest V3 and WebAssembly, running offline in Chrome's native Side Panel with zero DOM injection.
